results.title: Volvo CE Appoints Laothani Tractor as New Dealer in Laos
results.content: Volvo Construction Equipment (Volvo CE) and its new national distributor in Laos, Laothani Tractor, have launched their partnership with a dealer inauguration and customer roadshow showcasing Volvo CE’s latest excavators and compaction machines. results.title: Vientiane Forecasts Faster Economic Growth This Year
results.content: Vientiane Capital expects its economy to grow by 7.6 percent this year, falling short of its 8 percent target as handicraft production, mining, and tourism-related businesses face slower growth. The report, presented on 10 November, showed that Vientiane’s economy grew by 6.2 percent in the first nine months, above the national rate of 4.8 percent. […]
